sentences.text: When there is at least one sort, no generalized H E P derivor can produce it:
a derivor takes all the cells of a sort from a single carrier, but an omega-dimensional cell may come from any drawer.
Instead, for every sort, we take the cells of all dimensions and glue each cell to its identities.
With it, graduation and unification are again an adjoint equivalence, and the algebraic square holds between a finite dimension and omega.
